items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Lawrence and Mealy was working there for us... Gilly. Mealy was Gilly. I believe it was Gilly on drums.

ctx.x: What was that? Lawrence. No, Mealy and Mealy worked together down there. Lawrence and Mealy was working there for us, they got really defied Lawrence. And, uh, Mealy and Lawrence, and, uh, Gilly, what did he make the drummer name? Gilly. Mealy was Gilly. I believe it was Gilly on drums. Well, that's enough.
Gilly ain't gonna find his name. I believe it was Gilly on drums. Mm-hmm.
